register_state_choices: register state choices for an entity type using the decorator pattern with a Django TextChoices class
register_state_model: register a state model for an entity type using the decorator pattern with a BaseState subclass
register_state_transition: register a state transition with trigger metadata for creation, update, or field change events
get_state_model_for_entity: get the state model class for a Django model entity using its meta model name
test_state_choices_registry: test the StateChoicesRegistry class by registering and clearing state choices for multiple entities
